title: frangula rupestris
intro: Frangula rupestris, commonly known as Alpine Buckthorn, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rhamnaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, where it has been used to treat digestive issues and alleviate symptoms of constipation. The therapeutic actions of Frangula rupestris are attributed to its anthraquinone glycosides, which act as a laxative and help to stimulate bowel movements. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinone glycosides, such as aloe-emodin, emodin, and rhein, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
